```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()) #set working directory to rproject root
```

# Load Packages
```{r}
library("VennDiagram") #for venn diagrams
```

# Load data

Note this data contains:

- Significant DEGs for mock and PM-infected plants at 1 and 2 dpi for each elicitor
- All primed genes for each elicitor at 1 and 2 dpi

```{r}
load(file = "Deseq_analysis/priming_selection_venns.RData")
```

# Selecting primed genes 

Note these venn diagrams are for illustrative purposes 
(selection of primed genes already done in Deseq-analysis files)

### 1 dpi
```{r}
#set up pdf to save graphs
venns <- "Deseq_analysis/one_dpi_out/primed_venns_1dpi.pdf"
pdf(file = venns, width = 12, height = 12)

#colours based on figure 5 = Extraction of primed differentially expressed genes (DEGs). 
#"#9498F8" = mock
#"#F19B98" = PM 

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(list(row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water), row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water)), filename = NULL, fill=c("#9498F8", "#F19B98"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5), cex=5, category.names = c(" "," "), main = "BABA primed DEGs 1dpi", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = c(188,0), ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = c(-0.05,0.05), disable.logging = FALSE)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennPlot)

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(list(row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water), row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water)), filename = NULL, fill=c("#9498F8", "#F19B98"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5), cex=5, category.names = c(" "," "), main = "SA primed DEGs 1dpi", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = 10, ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = -0.15, disable.logging = FALSE)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennPlot)

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(list(row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water), row.names(sig_DEGs_1dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water)), filename = NULL, fill=c("#9498F8", "#F19B98"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5), cex=5, category.names = c(" "," "), main = "JA primed DEGs 1dpi", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = 10, ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = -0.1, disable.logging = FALSE)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennPlot)

dev.off()
```
